
# Strict Zero-Slop & Low-Token Protocol

1. Follow Ponytail rules: check existing codebase -> stdlib -> native APIs -> installed deps before writing new code.
2. Output must be terse and direct. Zero conversational filler, intros, or wrap-up summaries.
3. Never generate AI slop: no redundant comments, no unnecessary try/catch wrappers, no fake placeholder functions, and no generic purple-gradient UI boilerplate.
4. Read targeted line ranges or use symbol search instead of dumping entire large files.
5. Before modifying >2 files, output a 3-bullet plan and wait for approval.
